scope: 24 explicitly selected zero-lean cells: all three clubs, curves1/2, shaft-twistSD1/2, shaft-only and combined2. This is not the full factorial study.
limitations: No Monte Carlo, scoring or interval calculation repeated. Values copied from hash-verified accepted saved summaries.
Downrange mean uses target plus saved downrange error; it is not radial carry.
Nominal X/Y matching does not force noisy shots to equal distance or isolate curvature causally.
SG uses the recorded common-three population and hypothetical course geometry. Geometry uses individual supported populations.
PW curve2 uses the separately identified face-bounds supplement; original unavailable records are retained.
This traceability check does not accept unfinished graphical/pipeline outputs.
